other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Wheat flour milling plant operating continuously across three 8-hour shifts (7am-3pm, 3pm-11pm, 11pm-7am), i.e. round-the-clock grain-processing production with roller mills
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The reports are organized according 
to the work shifts of the plant (7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.), (3:00 p.m. 
to 11:00 p.m.) and (11:00 pm to 7:00 am.).

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Large-throughput flour mill with continuous grinding lines and stated daily/annual production capacities
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The wheat mill plant studied produces approximately 420 t of 
flour daily and 150 Mt/year. It has two cleaning and grinding 
systems named Mill 1 and Mill 2 with capacities of 18 and 14.5 t/h 
respectively.

one_line: The paper develops and validates a new multiple-linear-regression energy performance indicator (EnPI) for the energy management system of a wheat flour milling plant in Cuba, a food-industry grain-processing context not among the registered Corpus B sectors.
